properties.name: app.seeding.enabled
properties.description: Enable sample-data seeding on startup. NEVER set to true in production — creates loginable accounts with a well-known password.

properties.name: cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins. Each value is trimmed. Example: https://app.example.com,https://admin.example.com

properties.name: app.git-sha
properties.description: Commit the running build came from, resolved from APP_GIT_SHA (CI build-arg) then RENDER_GIT_COMMIT (Render). Surfaced by /api/health.

properties.name: news.publish-cron
properties.description: Cron for the scheduled-publish sweep that flips due news articles from DRAFT to PUBLISHED. Fires in UTC. The sweep is an idempotent bulk UPDATE, so every replica may run it.
